ja: 『鉄血のオルフェンズ』公式外伝「機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ月鋼」より、主人公機「ガンダム・アスタロト」が最速立体化！
• 本体各所に3mm径の穴を設けており、様々な組み合わせでパーツ換装可能。■バルバトスを始めとする他のガンダム・フレーム機体と共通のフレームを内蔵し、カスタマイズも可能なほか、左腕のサブナックルを他の機体へ装備させることもできる！■収納形態に変形可能な大型武装「デモリッション・ナイフ」など個性的な武装も付属！
en: From the official "Iron-Blooded Orphans" side story "Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans Steel", the main character machine "Gundam Astaroth" has become the fastest three-dimensional figure!

• There are 3mm diameter holes in various parts of the main body, allowing parts to be replaced in various combinations. ■It has a built-in frame that is common to other Gundam/Frame aircraft, including Barbatos, and can be customized, as well as the left arm sub-knuckle can be attached to other aircraft! ■Includes unique weapons such as the large armament "Demolition Knife" that can be transformed into a storage form!
